<ic>Dispersal of funds for the enlargement of the Golden Sun. This is a limited time opportunity to commission with a saving of 50 wains of mithril and 100 crowns compared to standard enlargement costs.<br>''Proposed by Weirwater, seconded by Tassato.''</ic>

* To enlarge the Golden Sun army, in line with the [[opportunity]] presented by the [[Swords_and_sorcery#Golden_Sun|recent proposal]].

==Cost==

* 100 wains of mithril
* 200 crowns
* Nine months to complete

{{CommissionProgress|Enlarge_Golden_Sun}}
